name: Asha Bell
seed: To keep meaningful friendships after leaving the road and teach a new handler without recreating herself.
design: Sable-and-white anthropomorphic collie, soft green coat, orange knitted scarf and walking staff; distinct from quadrupedal Snow.
history: A Wayfarer handler and route cook who raised Snow within a household and retired three years before the pilot.
desire: To keep meaningful friendships after leaving the road and teach a new handler without recreating herself.
contradiction: Pretends not to miss the work, then gives unsolicited route advice.
relationships: Snow recognizes her; Madger respects her cues; Sela is an old colleague.
arc: Accepts being needed differently, with visits and teaching rather than emergency journeys she cannot sustain.
story_engine: Snow’s reunion is joyous without implying she must choose one family; an old route recipe reconnects two travelers.
writer_truth: Retirement was a deliberate good decision, not a secret illness or abandonment.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
